summary: Phase 5 (session timeout + advance payment milestone indicator) tested end-to-end. All backend (4/4) and frontend acceptance criteria PASS.

issues: Pre-existing console hydration warnings: <span> cannot be child of <tbody>/<tr> (carry-over from previous iterations, not new in Phase 5).
Pre-existing 'Each child in a list should have unique key prop' warning in PaymentMilestones TableBody. Not blocking, but should be cleaned up.

action_items: (Optional, pre-existing) Clean up React hydration warnings (<span> wrapper inside <tbody>/<tr>) and add unique key props in PaymentMilestones TableBody.
critical_code_review_comments: useIdleTimeout hook: implementation is sound — uses refs for timers, listens to ACTIVITY_EVENTS, shows warning warningMs before idleMs, suppresses activity reset while warning is open (so countdown is not bypassed). onTimeoutRef latest-callback pattern correctly used.

App.js integrates the hook only when user is logged in and renders AlertDialog with the required testids: session-timeout-warning-dialog, session-timeout-countdown, session-timeout-extend-btn, session-timeout-logout-btn.

Cashflow endpoint (financials.py): correctly extends wave_monthly when cash_in_idx falls beyond duration and only adds payment_amount to advance_revenue when ms.is_advance is True. total_advance is computed at wave, combined-month, and summary levels.
PaymentMilestones.js: Advance checkbox uses data-testid={`ms-advance-${ms.id}`} and renders 'Adv' badge when ms.is_advance is true — both verified at runtime.

CashflowStatement.js: advance-summary-card renders only when summary.total_advance > 0 (verified: card hidden for $0 advance project, visible for project with $25K advance). Per-wave row gets purple bg + 'Advance' badge; Combined row shows 'Adv' badge — verified.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5 fully verified. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration55_phase5.py (pytest, 4 tests). Session timeout dialog confirmed NOT visible at idle=0; full 13-minute wait was NOT performed (15-min idle threshold is production setting per testing instructions).
